name: ai.agentapigate/google-news-articles-headlines-mcp
title: AgentAPIGate — Real-Time Google News Headlines, Articles & Topics MCP
description: Real-time Google News headlines, breaking publisher articles & topic search remote MCP server.

tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Search 145 real-time APIs across x, search, social, commerce, b2b, finance, local, intel. Returns id, price_usd, p50_ms, summary.

query.description: Keyword query, e.g. "youtube transcript", "sec filings", or "hotel prices".

tools.name: get_endpoint_schema
tools.description: Get JSON input schema, price, and sample params for an endpoint_id.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Execute any endpoint (e.g. search.google.web, search.google.news, web.extract.markdown, youtube.video.transcript) and return compact LLM-ready output (-80% context tokens).

endpoint_id.description: Target endpoint ID from search_endpoints, e.g. "search.google.web".

params.description: Endpoint request arguments matching get_endpoint_schema, e.g. {"q":"MCP servers","limit":5}.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Inspect paid_usd, bonus_usd, rate limit, and active sub-key caps.
